#### Key Fields in MeijerItem:
```python
# Core product identification
data_id: str                    # Product ID
data_ean: int                   # EAN barcode
value: str                      # Product title/name
data_description: str           # Product description

# Pricing and availability
data_price: float               # Current price
data_isbuyable: bool           # Available for purchase
data_stocklevelstatus: str     # Stock status
data_priceunit: str            # Price unit (ea, lb, etc.)

# Store and fulfillment
data_isbopas: bool             # Buy Online Pickup At Store
data_pickupavailableflag: bool # Pickup availability
data_homedeliverynotavailable: bool # Delivery restrictions

# Product attributes
data_brand: str                # Brand name
data_image_url: str            # Product image URL
data_isalcohol: bool           # Alcohol product flag
data_isagerestricted: bool     # Age restriction flag
data_chokinghazard: bool       # Safety warning

# mPerks and promotions
data_hasmperks: bool           # Has mPerks offers
data_mperksofferid: List[Any]  # Associated mPerks offer IDs
data_specialbuy: bool          # Special promotion flag
data_sale: bool                # Sale item flag

# Nutrition and compliance
data_ebtfoodstampable: bool    # EBT/SNAP eligible
data_ingredients: Optional[str] # Ingredient list
data_depositvalue: Optional[float] # Bottle deposit
```

## 📋 Usage Examples

### Basic Search
```python
from meijer_search import MeijerSearch

search = MeijerSearch()
results = search.search("milk", store_id="217")

for item in results:
    print(f"{item.title} - ${item.price}")
    print(f"  Available: {item.data_isbuyable}")
    print(f"  mPerks: {item.data_hasmperks}")
```

### Autocomplete
```python
suggestions = search.autocomplete("mil")
# Returns: ["milk", "milk chocolate", "milk powder", ...]
```

### Category Browse
```python
dairy_items = search.browse_category("dairy-products")
for item in dairy_items:
    print(f"{item.title} by {item.brand}")
```

### With Meijer Client Integration
```python
from meijer_search import MeijerWithSearch
from meijer_comprehensive import MeijerComprehensiveClient

meijer = MeijerComprehensiveClient()
meijer.login_with_credentials(username, password)

search = MeijerWithSearch(meijer)
results = search.search_products("bread")

# Items can be added to cart
for item in results[:3]:
    item.add_to_cart(quantity=1)
```
